WHO WE ARE
 Drishti Astro is a decision-making brand. People come to us stuck on the biggest decisions of their life — which career, whom and when to marry, where to put their money — and we use Vedic astrology as the tool to make that decision clear : what their own birth chart supports, when the timing is strongest, and what to do next. Led by an astrologer with 20 years of practice, we give the decision in writing first, in a personalised report, and then clear every doubt in a one-to-one consultation. Most of our customers are Hindi-speaking families aged 40+, and almost every conversation happens on WhatsApp.
 Vision: To become India's most trusted name for taking life's important decisions through Vedic astrology.
 Mission: Guide individuals — using Vedic astrology — in taking the important decisions of their life in career, relationships and finances.
 The role in one line: make sure every customer leaves able to take their decision with confidence — own customer satisfaction and retention end to end: find out why customers are happy, unhappy or don't come back, then design, ship and measure the fixes yourself, using AI wherever it helps.
 OUR CORE VALUES
 Customer First — Only Promise What Can Be Delivered 
 “जो दे सकते हैं, वही कहेंगे।” 
The customer's need decides what we build, and we commit only to what we can actually deliver.
 Resilience / Adaptability 
 “जो बदले, उसके साथ बदलो — बिना घबराए।” 
We adapt quickly without losing the core. A setback is information, not a verdict.
 Measurable Outcome 
 “जो नापा नहीं गया, वो हुआ ही नहीं।” 
Every decision is judged on a number, not an opinion. If it can't be measured, it can't be claimed.
 FOUR CORE RESPONSIBILITIES
 01 Research
Talk to customers (calls, WhatsApp, surveys) — before and after they buy.
Read report ratings, feedback and support chats to find the real reasons behind low satisfaction.
 02 Analyse
Map the journey: ad → website → checkout → report → rating → repeat purchase → consultation.
Find where satisfaction and repeat buying drop, with numbers (funnels, cohorts, session recordings).
 03 Manage
Turn findings into a ranked backlog with a clear metric per item.
Write simple specs; work with the founder, marketing and engineering (in-house and AI tools) to deliver.
 04 Execute
Ship the fix — report improvements, follow-up journeys, feedback loops, AI assistants.
Test it, measure the result against the target, keep or roll back.
 Research → Analyse → Prioritise → Ship → Measure → Repeat 
 WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE (FIRST 90 DAYS)
 Day 30: A clear, data-backed list of the top reasons customers rate us low or don't return.
 Day 60: Fixes for the top two reasons shipped and being measured.
 Day 90: A measurable rise in report ratings and repeat-purchase rate, and a working feedback loop that keeps finding the next problem.
 MUST-HAVE
3+ years in product management, growth or customer experience at a consumer (B2C) product.
Proven work on retention, engagement or satisfaction — and the numbers to show for it.
Hands-on with user research and product analytics (e.g. Mixpanel, PostHog, Microsoft Clarity, GA, SQL / spreadsheets).
Uses AI/LLM tools in daily work and can design AI-powered product features.
 Comfortable speaking and writing in Hindi — you will talk to our customers.
Individual contributor mindset: you do the work yourself, end to end.
 GOOD TO HAVE
Experience with WhatsApp-first journeys, CRM (Zoho) or consumer apps for 40+ users.
Ran A/B tests and can read whether a result is real.
Can prototype with no-code / low-code tools (n8n, Make, simple front-end).
Interest in astrology, spirituality or wellness products.
 NOT THE RIGHT FIT IF
You mainly manage teams or write documents without shipping.
Your experience is only B2B / enterprise, with no consumer customers.
 ENGAGEMENT & COMPENSATION
 Engagement: Part-time / Full-time, remote
 Compensation: ₹6–12 LPA (₹6,00,000 – ₹12,00,000 per year), based on experience and engagement type
 Reports to: Founder & CEO, working closely with the CMO
 Start date: Immediate
